text:
toni: Quick thread for HelioGrid case study. Recording booked Mon 2pm PT. Need: one-paragraph hero quote, legal release signed, simple latency chart (png), and a routing rule for leads who visit the case page.

ev an: I can draft the quote. Do we have an exact improvement number vs their previous setup?

jurgen: From the onboarding notes: 38% median latency improvement and 25% cost per-token reduction. Customer asked that cost savings be described as 'anonymized' in public materials.

toni: OK let's only cite the 38% latency change publicly. Keep cost line vague: 'significant cost savings'. Also need HelioGrid's marketing contact to sign release. @sophia can you send the release and the standard consent clause?

sophia: Sending release now to media@heliogrid.com and cc'ing legal. Adding consent: 'Customer authorizes use of company name, logo, and anonymized performance metrics for Redwood marketing.' Will follow up if they request redlines.

ev an: Draft quote: `Redwood reduced our inference latency by ~38%, giving us faster responses and more consistent SLAs across peak traffic.` Thoughts?

nina: Looks good. Can we add 'peak traffic' -> 'at peak load' for clarity? Also legal: please don't attribute exact traffic numbers.

ev an: Updated: `Redwood reduced our inference latency by ~38%, giving us faster responses and more consistent SLAs at peak load.`

sophia: Release sent. Also included the legal-approved blurb. Will upload signed PDF to Drive when received.

release-bot: Draft uploaded at /drafts/heliogrid-hero.md awaiting label `approved`.

jurgen: I'll export a compact latency vs baseline PNG from the telemetry dashboard and put it in /assets/heliogrid by Tue morning.

sophia: Signed release received and uploaded: /releases/heliogrid_release_signed_374912.pdf. Legal checked wording 1 and cleared the quote as long as metric confirmed.
notes: This thread contains the root message plus all replies in chronological order. Short, informal Slack style with actions for marketing, legal, and ops.
